# Ancaster Heating & Cooling

> Ancaster Heating & Cooling provides heating and cooling service to homeowners in and around Ancaster, Hamilton-Wentworth, Ontario. The team handles furnace and AC repair, ductless mini-split installation, heat pump service, gas fireplace work, thermostat upgrades, and duct cleaning.

Phone: (289) 204-2884  |  Email: contact@ancasterheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://ancasterheatingcooling.ca

Service areas: Ancaster, Hamilton, Stoney Creek, Dundas, Waterdown, Binbrook, Mount Hope
